boxes.meaning: to replace, take the place of

english.note: Use this when one thing replaces another because it is better, newer, or more suitable.
Use this for an alternative that takes over a role or function, especially in an abstract or lasting replacement.

examples.english: The new system will displace the old one.
examples.jyutping: san1 hai6 tung2 wui5 ceoi2 doi6 gau6 go2 tou3

examples.english: In future, robots may substitute for many jobs.
examples.traditional: 將來機械人可能會取代好多工種。
examples.jyutping: zoeng1 loi4 gei1 haai6 jan4 ho2 nang4 wui5 ceoi2 doi6 hou2 do1 gung1 zung2
